question: What is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 37,500 for \(1\frac{1}{3}\) years at a rate of 12% p.a if the interest is compounded 8 – monthly?
question_hi: 37,500 रु. पर 12% वार्षिक दर से \(1\frac{1}{3}\) वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज क्या होगा, यदि ब्याज 8-महीने में चक्रवृद्धि होता है?
solution:
P = 37500

r = 12% p. a

t =  years = 16 months

If interest is compounded 8 monthly, then

r = (12/12) × 8 = 8%

t = 16/8 = 2

As we know

A = P(1 + r/100)t

A = 37500(1 + 8/100)2

A = 37500 × (27/25) × (27/25)

A = 43740

CI = 43740 – 37500 = 6240

SHORT TRICK:

8% = 2/25

625 unit = 37500

1 unit = 60

(729 – 625) = 104 unit = 60 × 104 = 6240

question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90° and CD is perpendicular to AB at D. If AD/BD = √k, then AC/BC = ?
question_hi: ΔABC में, ∠C = 90° और CD, बिंदु D पर AB के लम्बवत है। यदि AD/BD = √k, तो AC/BC = ?
solution:
In ΔABC and ΔACD

∠ACB = ∠CDA,

∠CAD = ∠CAB

⇒ ΔABC ∼ ΔACD

⇒ AC/AB = AD/AC

⇒ AC² = AB × AD      ----(1)

Similary,

In ΔCBD and ΔABC

⇒ ΔCBD ∼ ΔABC

⇒ BC/BA = BD/BC

⇒ BC² = BA × BD     ----(2)

From (1) and (2),

⇒ AC²/BC² = (AB × AD)/(BA × BD)

⇒ (AC/BC)2 = AD/BD

⇒ (AC/BC)2 = √k

⇒ AC/BC = ∜k

Shortcut Trick 

 If ABC is a right-angled triangle and CD⊥ AB we have,

⇒ AD/BD = (AC/BC)2

⇒ √k = (AC/BC)2

⇒ (AC/BC) = (√k)1/2 = ∜k

∴ The correct answer is ∜k.
solution_hi:
ΔABC और ΔACD में

∠ACB = ∠CDA,

∠CAD = ∠CAB

⇒ ΔABC ∼ ΔACD

⇒ AC/AB = AD/AC

⇒ AC² = AB × AD      ----(1)

इसी प्रकार,

ΔCBD और ΔABC में

⇒ ΔCBD ∼ ΔABC

⇒ BC/BA = BD/BC

⇒ BC² = BA × BD     ----(2)

समीकरण (1) और (2) से,

⇒ AC²/BC² = (AB × AD)/(BA × BD)

⇒ (AC/BC)2 = AD/BD

⇒ (AC/BC)2 = √k

⇒ AC/BC = ∜k

Shortcut Trick 

 यदि ABC एक समकोण त्रिभुज है और CD⊥ AB, तब हमारे पास है,

⇒ AD/BD = (AC/BC)2

⇒ √k = (AC/BC)2

⇒ (AC/BC) = (√k)1/2 = ∜k

∴ सही उत्तर ∜k है।

question: PT is a tangent at the point R on a circle with centre O. SQ is a diameter, which when produced meets the tangent PT at P. If ∠SPT = 32°, then what will be the measure of ∠QRP?
question_hi: PT, O केंद्र वाले एक वृत्त पर बिंदु R पर एक स्पर्शरेखा है। SQ एक व्यास है, जो बढाने पर बिंदु P पर स्पर्शरेखा PT से मिलता है। यदि ∠SPT = 32°, तो ∠QRP का माप क्या होगा?
solution:
Given, ∠SPT = 32°

As we know,

OR is perpendicular to PT, so ∠ORP = 90°

Suppose ∠QRP = θ

As we know, sum of two interior opposite angles of a triangle is equal to its exterior angle.

∠OQR = 32° + θ

∠OQR = ∠ORQ = 32° + θ [same radii]

Now,

∠ORP = ∠ORQ + QRP

90° = 32° + θ + θ

2θ = 90° – 32° = 58°

θ = 58/2 = 29°

So, ∠QRP = 29°
solution_hi:
दिया है, ∠SPT = 32°

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

OR, PT के लम्बवत है, इस प्रकार ∠ORP = 90°

माना ∠QRP = θ

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, एक त्रिभुज के दो आंतरिक विपरीत कोणों का योगफल उसके बाहरी कोण के बराबर होता है।

∠OQR = 32° + θ

∠OQR = ∠ORQ = 32° + θ [समान त्रिज्याएं]

अब,

∠ORP = ∠ORQ + QRP

90° = 32° + θ + θ

2θ = 90° – 32° = 58°

θ = 58/2 = 29°

इस प्रकार, ∠QRP = 29°

question: A is 40% less than B, and C is 40% of the sum of A and B. The difference between A and B is what percentage of C?
question_hi: A, B से 40% कम है और C A और B के योगफल का 40% है। A और B के बीच अंतर C का कितना प्रतिशत है?
solution:
Let the value of B be 100.

Value of A = 100 × (60/100) = 60

Value of C = (60 + 100) × (40/100) = 64

Required difference = [(100 – 60)/64] × 100 = 62.5%

question: In a test consisting of 140 questions, a candidate correctly answered 70% of the first 80 questions. What percentage of the remaining question does the candidate need to correctly answer to score 60% in the test?
question_hi: 140 प्रश्नों की एक परीक्षा में, एक उम्मीदवार ने पहले 80 प्रश्नों में से 70% का सही उत्तर दिया। परीक्षा में 60% अंक प्राप्त करने के लिए उम्मीदवार को शेष प्रश्नों का कितना प्रतिशत सही उत्तर देने की आवश्यकता है?
solution:
Total questions = 140

Let the percentage be x in the remaining question does the candidate need to correctly answer.

According to the question

80 × (70/100) + 60 × (x/100) = 140 × (60/100)

56 + (3x/5) = 84

3x/5 = 84 – 56 = 28

x = 28 × (5/3) = 140/3 = \(46\frac{2}{3}\%\)

माना उम्मीदवार को शेष प्रश्नों का x प्रतिशत सही उत्तर देने की आवश्यकता है।

x = 28 × (5/3) = 140/3 = \(46\frac{2}{3}\%\)

question: A can do 4/5 of a work in 20 days and B can do 3/4 of the same work in 15 days. They work together for 10 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 1 day. B and C together can complete 3/4 the same work in:
question_hi: A एक कार्य का 4/5 भाग 20 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है और B उसी कार्य का 3/4 भाग 15 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है। वे एक साथ 10 दिन कार्य करते हैं। C अकेले शेष कार्य को 1 दिन में पूरा करता है। B और C एक साथ कार्य के 3/4 भाग को कितने दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं?
solution:
A can do 4/5 of a work in = 20 days

A can do the whole work in = 20 × (5/4) = 25 days

B can do ¾ of the work in = 15 days

B can do the whole work in = 15 × (4/3) = 20 days

Total work = 100

Work done by A and B in 10 days = (4 + 5) × 10 = 90

Remaining work = 100 – 90 = 10

Let efficiency of C be x, then

x × 1 = 10

x = 10

¾ of the total work B and C complete in = [100 × (3/4)]/(10 + 5) = 75/15 = 5 days

question: How many natural numbers less than 1000 are divisible by 5 or 7 but NOT by 35?
question_hi: 1000 से छोटी कितनी प्राकृतिक संख्याएँ 5 या 7 से विभाज्य हैं लेकिन 35 से नहीं?
solution:
Number less than 1000 are divisible by 5 are = {(1000)/5} - 1 = 200 - 1 = 199

Number less than 1000 are divisible by 7 are = (1000/7) = 142

Number less than 1000 are divisible by 35 are = (1000/35) = 28

Number less than 1000 are divisible by 7 or 5 but not 35 are = 199 + 142 – (2 × 28) = 285Confusion Points 
2 × 28, We have taken this due to

199 - 28 = 171

Number less than 1000 are divisible by 7 are = {(994 – 7)/7} + 1 = 142

142 - 28 = 114

⇒ Total number is not divisible by 171 + 114 = 285.

question: Let x be the least number of 4 digits that when divided by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 leaves a remainder of 1 in each case. If x lies between 2000 and 2500, then what is the sum of the digits of x?
question_hi: x 4 अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या है जिसे 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 और 7 से विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल 1 प्राप्त होता है। यदि x 2000 से 2500 के बीच में आता है, तो x के अंकों का योगफल क्या है?
solution:
LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 7 = 420

LCM of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 is 420.

Number should be between 2000 and 2500 so, the number is = 420 × 5 = 2100

Remainder will be 1 in each case so the number is = 2100 + 1 = 2101

Sum of digit of the number 2101 is = 2 + 1 + 0 + 1 = 4

question: A and B together can do a certain work in x days. Working alone, A and B can do the same work in (x + 8) and (x + 18) days, respectively. A and B together will complete 5/6 of the same work in:

question: A circular park whose diameter is 210 m has a 5 m wide path running around it (on the outside). What is the area (in m<sup>2</sup>) of the path?

solution:
Given:

Radius of park (r) = 210/2 = 105

Formula used:

Area of circle = πr2

Calculation:

Radius of park and path combine (R) = 105 + 5 = 110

Area of path = π(R2 – r2)

⇒ π (1102 – 1052)

⇒ π(110 + 105) (110 – 105)

⇒ 215 × 5 × π = 1075 π

∴ The area of the path is 1075π m2.

question: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26 and x<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>3</sup> + z<sup>3</sup> = 151, then what will be the value of xyz?
question_hi: यदि x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26 और x3 + y3 + z3 = 151 है, तो xyz का मान क्या होगा?
solution:
Given:

x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26, and x3 + y3 + z3 = 151

Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2 – xy – yz – zx)

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

Calculation:

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 [12 – 3 × ( – 26)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 + 78 = 79

⇒ 3xyz = 151 – 79 = 72

⇒ xyz = 72/3 = 24

∴ The value of xyz is 24.

question: The volume of a solid right circular cone is 600π cm<sup>3</sup>, and the diameter of its base is 30 cm. The total surface area (in cm<sup>2</sup>) of the cone is:
question_hi: एक ठोस लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकु का आयतन 600π घन सेमी है और इसके आधार का व्यास 30 सेमी है। शंकु का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल कितना है?
solution:
Given:

The volume of a solid right circular cone is 600π cm3.

Radius of cone r = 30/2 = 15 cm

Formula used:

The volume of cone = \(1\over3\)πr2h

Calculation:

The volume of cone = \(1\over3\)πr2h

⇒ \(1\over3\) × π × 15 × 15 × h = 600π

⇒​ h = (600 × 3)/(15 × 15)

⇒​ h = 8 cm

⇒​ l2 = r2 + h2

⇒​ l2 = 152 + 82 = 225 + 64 = 289

⇒​ l = √289 = 17 cm

Total surface area = πr(r + l)

⇒​ π × 15 × (15 + 17)

⇒​ π × 15 × 32 = 480π cm2.

question: A field is in the shape of a trapezium whose parallel sides are 200 m and 400 m long. Whereas each of the other two sides is 260 m long. What is the area (in m<sup>2</sup>) of the field?

solution:
Given:

The parallel sides are 200 m and 400 m long.

The other two sides are 260 m long.

Formula used:

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel side) × (Distance between parallel side)

Calculation:

ABCD is a trapezium

AB = 200, CD = 400, BC = AD = 260

AB = EF = 200 cm and DE = FC

CD = DE + EF + FC

400 = DE + 200 + DE

2DE = 400 – 200 = 200

(260)2 = BF2 + (100)2

BF = √57600 = 240 cm

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (400 + 200) × 240 = 120 × 600 = 72000 m2

question: A man spends 2/3<sup>rd</sup> of his income. If his income increases by 14% and the expenditure increases by 20%. Then the percentage increase in his savings will be
question_hi: एक आदमी अपनी आय का दो/तिहाई भाग व्यय करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 14% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो तब उसकी बचत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि कितनी होगी?
solution:
Given:

A man spends 2/3rd of his income.

If his income increases by 14% and the expenditure increases by 20%.

Calculation:

Let the income of the man be 300.

Expenditure of the man = 300 × (2/3) = 200

Savings of the man = 300 – 200 = 100

New income of the man = 300 × (114/100) = 342

New expenditure of the man = 200 × (120/100) = 240

New saving of the man = 342 – 240 = 102

Required percentage = [(102 – 100)/100] × 100 = 2%
solution_hi:

एक आदमी अपनी आय का 2/3rd भाग व्यय करता है।

आदमी की बचत = 300 – 200 = 100

आदमी की नयी बचत = 342 – 240 = 102

अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = [(102 – 100)/100] × 100 = 2%

question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 3 : 5, whereas the ratio of their expenditures is 4 : 7 respectively. If A and B save Rs. 16,000 and Rs. 26,000, respectively, then what is the difference (in Rs.) between their expenditures?

⇒ -6

⇒ -6

∴ The value of a(b2 + c2) + b(c2 + a2) + c(a2 + b2) + 3abc is -6.

question: Pipes P and Q can fill a tank in 18 and 27 minutes, respectively, whereas pipe R can empty the full tank in 54 minutes. P and Q were opened together for 6 minutes and then closed and R was opened. The tank was emptied by R alone in:
question_hi: पाइप P और Q एक टंकी को क्रमशः 18 और 27 मिनट में भर सकते हैं, जबकि पाइप R पूरी टंकी को 54 मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। P और Q को एक साथ 6 मिनट के लिए खोला गया और फिर बंद कर दिया गया और पाइप R को खोल दिया गया। R द्वारा अकेले टंकी कितने समय में खाली हो गया?
solution:
Given:

Pipe P filling time = 18 minutes

Pipe Q filling time = 27 minutes

Pipe R empty time = 54 minutes

P and Q opened for 6 minutes

Formula used:

Capacity = time × efficiency

Calculation:

Total work = 54 unit

Work done by pipe P and Q in 6 min = (3 + 2) × 6 = 30

Pipe R empty the tank in = 30/1 = 30 min

∴ The correct answer is 30 min.

question: The total numbers of students in sections A and B of a class are 72. The ratio of the number of students in A and B is 7 : 5. The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 20% more than that of the students in section A. If the average weight of all the students in the class is 52 kg, then what is the average weight (in kg) of the students in section B?
question_hi: एक कक्षा के खंड A और B में छात्रों की कुल संख्या 72 है। A और B में छात्रों की संख्या का अनुपात 7: 5 है। खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन (किग्रा में), खंड A में छात्रों के औसत वजन से 20% से अधिक है। यदि कक्षा के सभी छात्रों का औसत वजन 52 किग्रा है, तो खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन (किग्रा में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:

The total numbers of students in sections A and B of a class are 72.

The ratio of the number of students in A and B is 7 : 5.

The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 20% more than that of the students in section A.

The average weight of all the students in the class is 52 kg,

Formula used:

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

Calculation:

The number of students = 72

Number of students in section A = 72 × (7/12) = 42

Number of students in section B = 72 – 42 = 30

Let the average weight of section A be 5x

Average weight of section B = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

According to the question

42 × 5x + 30 × 6x = 72 × 52

210x + 180x = 3744

390x = 3744

x = 3744/390 = 9.6

Average weight of students in section B = 6x = 6 × 9.6 = 57.6

∴ The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 57.6.

Alternate Method

Let the number of students in sections A and B are 7 and 5 respectively.

Let the average weight of section A be 5x.

Average weight of section B = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

According to the question

7 × 5x + 5 × 6x = 12 × 52

35x + 30x = 12 × 52

65x = 12 × 52

x = (12 × 52)/65 = 9.6

Average weight of section B = 9.6 × 6 = 57.6
solution_hi:

छात्रों की संख्या = 72

खंड A में छात्रों की संख्या  = 72 × (7/12) = 42

खंड B में छात्रों की संख्या  = 72 – 42 = 30

खंड A में छात्रों का औसत वजन 5x है

खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

प्रश्न के अनुसार

42 × 5x + 30 × 6x = 72 × 52

210x + 180x = 3744

390x = 3744

x = 3744/390 = 9.6

खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन = 6x = 6 × 9.6 = 57.6

वैकल्पिक हल:

माना खंड A और B में छात्रों की संख्या क्रमशः 7 और 5 है।

खंड A में छात्रों का औसत वजन 5x है

खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

प्रश्न के अनुसार

7 × 5x + 5 × 6x = 12 × 52

35x + 30x = 12 × 52

65x = 12 × 52

x = (12 × 52)/65 = 9.6

खंड B में छात्रों का औसत वजन = 9.6 × 6 = 57.6

question: A and B started traveling towards each other at the same time, from places X to Y and Y to X, respectively. After crossing each other, A and B took 2.45 hours and 4.05 hours to reach Y and X, respectively. If the speed of B was 8.4 km/h, then what was the speed (in km/h) of A?
question_hi: A और B ने एक ही समय में एक-दूसरे की ओर क्रमशः स्थान X से Y तक और Y से X तक की ओर यात्रा करना शुरू किया। एक-दूसरे को पार करने के बाद, A और B को क्रमशः Y और X तक पहुंचने में 2.45 घंटे और 4.05 घंटे लगे। यदि B की गति 8.4 किमी/घंटा थी, तो A की गति (किमी/घंटा में) कितनी थी?
solution:
Given:

After Crossing A took =  2.45 hours

After Crossing B took = 4.05 hours

Speed of B = 8.4 km/h

Concept used:

In such types of questions where time, after the crossing is given there following formula is used.

Speed of A/Speed of B = √[Time taken by B to reach X after crossing/Time taken by A to reach X after crossing]

Calculation:

Speed of A/8.4 = √(4.05/2.45) = √(81/49) = 9/7

Speed of A = (9/7) × 8.4 = 10.8 km/hr

∴ The correct answer is 10.8 km/hr.
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

पार करने के बाद A द्वारा लिया गया समय = 2.45 घंटे

पार करने के बाद B द्वारा लिया गया समय = 4.05 घंटे

B की गति = 8.4 किमी/घंटा

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

इस प्रकार के प्रश्नों में जहाँ, पार करने के बाद का समय दिया जाता है, वहाँ निम्न सूत्र का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

A की गति = (9/7) × 8.4 = 10.8 किमी/घंटा

∴ सही उत्तर 10.8 किमी/घंटा है।

question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is 1039.5 cm<sup>2</sup>. The volume (in cm<sup>3</sup>) of the hemisphere is: (Take π = 22/7)

⇒ r = 1.5 × 7 = 10.5

Volume of the hemisphere = (2/3) × π r3 = (2/3) × (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × `10.5 = 2425.5

∴ The correct answer is 2425.5

question: A person invested a sum of Rs. 18,600 at x% p.a and another sum that is twice the former at (x + 2)% p.a., both at simple interest. If the total interest earned on both investments for \(3\frac{1}{2}\) years is Rs. 23, 110.50, then the rate of interest p.a. on the second investment is:

question: A, B and C enter into a partnership by investing their capitals in the ratio of 2/5 : 3/4 : 5/8. After 4 months, A increased his capital by 50% but B decreased his capital by 20%. What is the share of B in the total profit of Rs. 2,82,100 at the end of a year?
question_hi: A, B और C अपनी पूंजियों को 2/5 : 3/4 : 5/8 के अनुपात में निवेश कर एक साझेदारी करते हैं। 4 महीने बाद, A ने अपनी पूंजी में 50% की वृद्धि की, लेकिन B ने अपनी पूंजी में 20% की कमी की। एक वर्ष के अंत में 2,82,100 रु. के कुल लाभ में B का लाभांश क्या है?
solution:
Ratio of capitals invested by A, B and C = 2/5 : 3/4 : 5/8 = 16 : 30 : 25

Let capital of A, B and C are 16x, 30x and 25x respectively.

Capital of A at the end of the year = 16x × 4 + 24x × 8 = 64x + 192x = 256x

Capital of B at the end of the year = 30x × 4 + 24x × 8 = 120x + 192x = 312x

Capital of C at the end of the year = 25x × 12 = 300x

Capital ratio of A, B and C at the end of the year = 256x : 312x : 300x = 64x : 78x : 75x

According to the question

64x + 78x + 75x = 282100

217x = 282100

x = 282100/217 = 1300

Profit share of B at the end of the year = 78x = 78 × 1300 = 101400

question: A solid metallic sphere of radius x cm is melted and then drawn into 126 cones each of radius 3.5 cm and height 3 cm. There is no wastage of material in this process. What is the value of x?
question_hi: x सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक ठोस धातु के गोले को पिघलाकर प्रत्येक 3.5  सेमी त्रिज्या और 3 सेमी ऊँचाई के 126 शंकु बनाये गये हैं। इस प्रक्रिया में सामग्री का अपव्यय नहीं हुआ है। x का मान क्या है?
solution:
Given:

Total number of cones = 126

Radius and Height of cone = 3.5 cm & 3 cm respectively.

Formula used:

The volume of sphere = (4/3) × πR3

Volume of cone = (1/3) × πr2h

Calculation:

According to the question

⇒ x3 = (126/4) × 3.5 × 3.5 × 3

⇒ x3 = 3 × 3 × 3.5 × 3.5 × 3.5 × 3

⇒ x = 3 × 3.5

⇒ x = 10.5 cm

∴ The correct answer is 10.5 cm

question: Three pipes, A, B and C, can fill a cistern in 12, 18 and 24 minutes, respectively, If all the pipes are opened together for 7 minutes, what will be the volume of the water that overflows as the percentage of the total volume of the cistern?
question_hi: तीन पाइप A, B और C एक टंकी को क्रमशः 12, 18 और 24 मिनट में भर सकते हैं, यदि सभी पाइपों को एक साथ 7 मिनट के लिए खोला जाता है, तो टंकी के कुल आयतन के प्रतिशत के रूप में बढ़े हुए पानी का आयतन क्या होगा?
solution:
Total work = 72

Work done by pipe A, B and C in 7 min = (6 + 4 + 3) × 7 = 91

Volume of the water that overflows = 91 – 72 = 19

Required percentage = (19/72) × 100 = \(26\frac{7}{{18}}\%\)

question: The average of ten numbers is 72. The average of the first four numbers is 69 and that of the next three numbers is 74. question_hi: दस संख्याओं का औसत 72 है। पहली चार संख्याओं का औसत 69 है और अगली तीन संख्याओं का औसत 74 है। 8वीं संख्या, 9वीं संख्या से 6 अधिक है और 10वीं संख्या से 12 अधिक है। 8वीं और 9वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
